metadata.title: SK Hynix jumps on big buyback proposal, and other early market movers - MarketWatch

content.text:
4 hours ago
SK Hynix jumps on big buyback proposal, and other early market movers
Here are some of the stocks making notable moves in Wednesday's premarket action:
SK Hynix's American Depository Receipts are jumping more than 6% after the South Korean memory-chip maker said it would buy back and cancel $29 billion worth of treasury shares.
That news bolstered other memory stocks, with Micron Technology reversing early losses to trade up 2% and Sandisk also wiping out an initial fall to gain nearly 3%.
Mercury Systems shares are down nearly 10% after the aerospace and defense technology company's results delivered record bookings but an earnings miss.
Keysight Technologies shares are up 3% after the software and hardware maker said profit and revenue grew in its latest quarter and it guided for fourth-quarter results that topped Wall Street estimates.
La-Z-Boy stock is diving 17%, though on minimal volume, after the furniture maker swung to a loss in its fiscal first quarter from an unexpected decline in sales.
